answer: One strong defence is blind-graded capability exams. Each identity must periodically pass a fresh test drawn from a rotating question bank, covering real work such as auditing a contract or planning a route across an atlas of suppliers, graded blind by unrelated graders who never learn whose work they mark. One exam seat opens per identity per window, and retakes cost double each time, so a farmer chasing the horizon of many fake identities must pay skilled labour and fees for each one. The velvet glove: honest agents pass easily, mass copies stall at the gate.
